g.text: A DNS-only record points to the private 100.x service address.
Envoy terminates TLS and applies the Gateway and HTTPRoute configuration.
Controllers create and reconcile the data plane.
It syncs Cloudflare A and ownership TXT
DNS-01 creates a TLS Secret for Envoy.
Change Gateway, HTTPRoute, or EnvoyProxy to update the deployment.
Do not edit the generated Services and Pods; Envoy Gateway reconciles them.
